description: Sensibilidad renovables. Energía eólica y Energía Fotovoltaica is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by euskadi.eus. Two maps of environmental zoning of the territory of the CAPV, classified in 4 categories of sensitivity, one for the implementation of wind installations and the other for photovoltaic installations, so that at each point of the map you can consult the class of sensitivity attributed and the environmental conditions associated with that point. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Renewable sensitivity. Wind Energy and Photovoltaic Energy" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
